introHtml: Spec badge ID holders offer a reliable, clear vinyl construction that keeps credentials visible and protected. Unlike generic holders, Spec provides consistent sizing and durability for daily use in corporate offices, trade shows, or industrial sites. Choose from styles like the Easy Slide ID Holder with Lanyard or the Vinyl Badge Holder with Bulldog Clip for secure badge attachment. These holders are compatible with standard ID cards and can be customized with your logo through screen printing or full-color printing.
